iron_fist.name: Iron Fist Style
iron_fist.description: Raw physical power channelled through hardened fists and elbows. The foundation of countless external martial arts.

eagle_claw.name: Eagle Claw Technique
eagle_claw.description: A grappling style that seizes limbs and pressure points. Excels at disarming and incapacitating.

diamond_palm.name: Diamond Iron Palm
diamond_palm.description: Decades of tempering condense Qi into the palm until it can shatter stone. Internal and external power in perfect unity.
